_comment: Every external host named in a shipped file (pages, scripts, styles, functions, headers). Kept in step with docs/PRIVACY_TECHNICAL_INVENTORY.md by tests/third-party-hosts.test.mjs. 'kind': first-party | runtime-on-demand (browser contacts it after a user action) | runtime-always (browser contacts it on page load) | server-side (only our functions contact it) | link (outbound link the user may click) | reference (namespace or comment, never fetched) | csp-allowance (allowed by the Content-Security-Policy but nothing in the shipped files loads from it) | disabled (named in config but switched off).

hosts.note: Supabase project (auth, database, realtime), region eu-west-1 (Ireland). Contacted for sessions and cloud sync of signed-in users.
